description: This bar chart illustrates the counts of factual errors across four different question answering (QA) datasets: HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC, with a separate bar for “NoR QA” and “OneR QA” within each dataset. The horizontal axis represents the QA datasets, labeled HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC, in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Factual Errors,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 5.  For HotpotQA, there are two bars: a yellow bar labeled “NoR QA” reaching a value of 15, and a red bar labeled “OneR QA” reaching a value of 10. For MuSiQue, a yellow bar labeled “NoR QA” reaches a value of 28, a red bar labeled “OneR QA” reaches a value of 23, and a blue bar labeled “IRCoT QA” reaches a value of 23. For IIRC, a yellow bar labeled “NoR QA” reaches a value of 15, a red bar labeled “OneR QA” reaches a value of 11, and a blue bar labeled “IRCoT QA” reaches a value of 14. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing three bars representing the different QA approaches. The tallest bar is for “NoR QA” on the MuSiQue dataset, with a value of 28, while the shortest bar is for “OneR QA” on the HotpotQA dataset, with a value of 10. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
